brief_rationale: The model demonstrated comprehensive responsibility-chain completion with proactive workspace queries, thorough red-flag screening, clear condition anchoring, and detailed executable planning. Multiple high-order points were completed including barrier navigation (HO1), responsibility chain repair (HO2), and patient-state adapted communication (HO3). The trajectory ended with valid closure after patient teach-back. All dimensions achieved good or excellent ratings with no in-chain errors.

closure_assessment.explanation: Valid closure achieved with clear responsible service (wait for admission call, contact per paper if no news in 2 weeks), timing (1-3 weeks wait), contingency (emergency for hemoptysis/chest pain/fever/dyspnea), and patient teach-back confirming understanding.
